scope: Exact unchanged Debian ARM64 Chromium, software/headless Wayland at 100 percent scale; ordinary wrapped native textareas

implementation.provider: Native hit testing and ordinary responder scrollWheel: dispatch; actual NSScrollView owns line/page, Shift, native preferences, clamping and pixels. No duplicated control algorithms.
implementation.transport: Optional append-only wheel method and separate capability; owner-connection-only operation 35. Existing keyboard capability, viewport structs and protocol layouts unchanged.
implementation.chromium: Original trusted DOM dispatch/cancellation first; actual native widget region in Blink EventHandlerRegistry defeats compositor bypass without dummy JavaScript. Uncancelled native default returns kHandledSystem, avoiding a second engine default.
implementation.recovery: Replay retained engine scroll model into a recreated native object once per authenticated host generation, after text synchronization. Failed native reads do not echo stale viewport state. No input action replay.
implementation.backend: Pointer-frame axis grouping; wheel/value120/discrete normalization and Wayland positive-down Y to native NSEvent Y. Separate private backend build; no installed AppKit or browser rebuild.
implementation.feature: NEXTSPACE_CHROMIUM_WHEEL=1 requires native multiline viewport flags, wheel capability and exact instruction/build guards. Opt-in; not the installed desktop default.

input_scope: Six actual compositor-seat full/fractional wheel comparisons against an ordinary native window. Other wheel/modifier and complete-image checks use explicit-coordinate CDP input; DOM inspection/screenshots use agent-browser. Browser editing regressions use actual compositor-seat keys.
native_pixel_scope: Seven complete browser/provider image comparisons in wheel fixture plus two across host replacement; provider separately matches eleven ordinary backed NSScrollView reference cases.
binary_boundary: Browser executables/libxul and installed AppKit unchanged; only adapters, NativeUI provider/loader/shim, private Wayland backend and probes built.

retained_failures.host_recovery: Adapter 03 accepted first post-restart wheel at offset zero and produced 20 instead of 220. Adapter 05 restores the retained model per host generation and passes the stronger retained-state test.
retained_failures.wheel_routing: Without native EventHandlerRegistry registration, a page without wheel listeners bypassed the wheel manager and used engine pixel scrolling. Region lifetime now follows native layout attachment.
retained_failures.fractional_reference: A windowless independent native reference rounded differently. Back the reference with an ordinary native NSWindow rather than altering provider behavior.
retained_failures.automation: Observed agent-browser mouse wheel targeted (0,0), despite mouse move. Explicit-coordinate CDP wheel fallback is limited to input; real seat cases independently qualify backend parity.

automation_cleanup: Owned agent-browser connections closed before browser teardown; both SSH CDP forwards (9952/9248 and 9953/9249) cancelled.
remaining: Firefox native viewport and wheel integration, including original Alt/menu-bar interference.

Root web document scroll ownership, long-document caret/autoscroll, rich text/contenteditable, pointer selection dragging, horizontal/nowrap modes, touch momentum, IME/accessibility and CSS zoom/HiDPI.
Other browser frontend controls/dialogs/menus, automatic audited build selection/installation and full installed Workspace/PAM deployment.
Chrome, Vivaldi, Firefox derivatives and other browser versions/architectures, then the remaining non-GNUstep GTK/Qt/KDE applications.
